title: A createShow branch that returns a scalar (FORMA-016 F5, found by the parity harness, FORMA-183)
contract: A branch of createShow (and a case of createSwitch, a row of createList) may return a string or a number instead of a Node. It is written as a Text node holding N(String(value)), as h() writes the same value as a child and as the walker writes the branch's DYN_TEXT: between the conditional's markers. null and undefined write nothing; so does a boolean (value rule 6: the compiler refuses a provable boolean in a text position, and every client path writes nothing). Strict adoption of a served text branch makes no write at all.
consumers: crates/forma-ir/src/walker.rs tests (show_text_branch_vectors): the SHOW_IF whose branch is a DYN_TEXT over a slot holding `value`; cases marked clientOnly have no walker form
packages/core/src/dom/__tests__/show-text-branch.test.ts: createShow, createSwitch and createList over every vector, then strict adoption of the walker's bytes
packages/core/e2e/show-text-branch.spec.ts: the same bytes parsed by the real engines and strictly adopted with zero mutation records
note: Hand-enumerated finite vectors. `text` is the text the branch contributes; `nothing` means the client appends no node at all (a string, even an empty one, appends a Text node). `html` is what the walker writes between the conditional markers, with the DYN_TEXT range around the text (an empty value is held by one U+200B).
